_comment: Prospective stage-gated re-prompt trial for XR-1 (no branching). See docs/stage_gated_reprompt.md. Natural rollouts on fresh seeds, three arms per (task, seed) with the same environment seed and the same policy sampling-seed schedule.
_whitelist_source: Recoverability ladder: P minus R from the same state was positive at ArrangeTea mug_on_tray in v1 (0/16 -> 4/16) and v2 (+0.20 to +0.35 at stage entry to +8 inferences) and at BreadSelection jam_on_cutting_board in v1 (0/20 -> 19/20, 5 parents). GarnishPancake has no whitelisted stage (v2 strawberry_on_pancake: -0.25 to -0.46): it is the control task on which gated_reprompt must equal baseline, and always_reprompt shows the harm of ungated switching.
_reprompt_step_cap_source: Steps from switch to target completion in ladder re-prompt branches that went on to succeed: ArrangeTea mug_on_tray 96% (v2, 23 branches) and 100% (v1) within 1280 steps; BreadSelection jam_on_cutting_board 100% (v1, 22 branches) within 960. 1280 = 80 XR-1 inferences of 16 steps.
_base_seed_source: 400007 has not been used by any previous XR-1 run (ladder: 300007, 310007, 320007, 340007).
_expected_success_rates_source: XR-1 natural-rate selections (docs/safe_xiaomi_dense_subtask.md), as in scripts/recoverability_ladder_xr1_pilot.json; planning only.
_success_step_fraction_source: Median natural success step / H in the v1+v2 ladder parents: ArrangeTea ~1350/2250, BreadSelection ~1100-1700/1950, GarnishPancake ~1100/2700; planning only.
_seeds_per_task_source: Set to 100 on 2026-10-19, before any trial rollout: the expected unconditional ArrangeTea effect (+0.05 to +0.10) is underpowered at 50 seeds per task; 100 seeds still fits one 24 h allocation on two workers (docs/stage_gated_reprompt.md).
